firstMismatch.c: Status of wizard (fervently neutral):  Level 1  HP 13(13)  AC 10, slippery fingers.
firstMismatch.javascript: throws UnsupportedEnlightenmentError before drawing the report

summary: The self-directed stethoscope reaches the GLIB branch in insight.c:ustatusline(), but JavaScript treats GLIB as an unsupported condition and throws before printing the status line. C reads only u.uprops[GLIB].intrinsic and appends ', slippery ' plus fingers_or_gloves(TRUE); unlike the earlier general-attributes caller, ustatusline() does not print a wizard timeout suffix. The full ustatusline() function is the claimed source scope, including its final visible-region clause; that clause is separately refused in JavaScript and follows the same source order and swallowed-region guard.

source.branch: use_stethoscope() calls ustatusline() for a self-directed horizontal listen; with GLIB active, ustatusline() appends the slippery-hands phrase before trapped, movement, concealment, invisibility, holder, visible-region, and final status output. The later region phrase is omitted while swallowed and distinguishes poison gas from vapor using reg_damg().
callers: apply.c:use_stethoscope() calls ustatusline() when confdir(FALSE) leaves u.dx and u.dy zero; js/apply.js:use_stethoscope() awaits ustatusline(state) on the corresponding production branch.
dependencies: do_wear.c:fingers_or_gloves(TRUE) is already implemented by js/do_wear.js:fingers_or_gloves().
region.c:visible_region_at() and reg_damg() already have JavaScript counterparts in js/region.js; the source check and returned region damage still need to match C's visibility and TTL rules.

evidence: The official v75 evaluation reports 177/227 screens and cursors, all 3082 RNG calls, with the first stop at zero-based step 177 on '.'; the C recording prints 'Status of wizard (fervently neutral):  Level 1  HP 13(13)  AC 10, slippery fingers.'.

nethack-c/upstream/src/apply.c:318-382 calls ustatusline() after confdir(FALSE) when u.dx and u.dy are both zero. The recipe grants the wizard character Glib, then applies an uncursed stethoscope to self; the recording reaches that call at step 177 with no RNG divergence.

nethack-c/upstream/src/insight.c:3402-3489 appends the GLIB clause at 3453-3454 using the intrinsic-only Glib macro from include/youprop.h:112, then calls fingers_or_gloves(TRUE). The timeout suffix appears in the separate general-attributes function at insight.c:1172, not in ustatusline(). ustatusline() later adds a visible-region phrase only when the hero is not swallowed and a visible, non-expired region contains the hero.

js/insight.js:3052-3063 lists GLIB in UNPORTED_USTATUS_CONDITIONS and ustatusline() throws before report construction when that intrinsic/extrinsic superset is truthy. Its final visible-region branch also throws instead of appending the C phrase.

The planned implementation scope is the complete insight.c:ustatusline() function, with the production caller already wired through js/apply.js:2674. Existing helper implementations in js/do_wear.js and js/region.js supply the C counterparts; no caller edits are currently indicated.
